question: Keď domáci kvások necháte dlhšie v chladničke bez kŕmenia, často sa na ňom vytvorí sivastá tekutina s ostrou, štipľavou vôňou. Čo okrem vody obsahuje predovšetkým?
source_excerpt: hooch literally consists of water, ethanol, other organic alcohols, VOCs, and starch, sugar, and some undigested flour

extra.why_interesting: Many home bakers who started baking during lockdown have seen this liquid and assumed the starter had gone bad or grown mould. In fact the yeast has been quietly brewing alcohol. The sharp smell is a clue the player can reason from.
extra.verification_notes: Hooch is widely described as water plus ethanol (alcohol) and some acids, so 'alcohol' is the standard answer; 'predovšetkým' is slightly loose but not wrong (https://www.youkneadsourdough.com.au/blogs/faq/what-is-hooch-in-a-sourdough-starter).

explanation: Hladné kvasinky zo zvyškov cukrov vyrábajú alkohol, ktorý vystúpi navrch. Angličtí pekári mu podľa starého slangového slova pre pálenku hovoria „hooch“. Kvások nie je pokazený, stačí tekutinu sliať a kvások nakŕmiť.

question: Domáci pekári majú jednoduchý test, či je kvások pripravený na cesto: lyžičku kvásku pustia do pohára s vodou. Čo musí kvások urobiť, aby test prešiel?
source_excerpt: The sourdough float test involves taking a scoop of unstirred sourdough starter and dropping it into a glass of water to see if it floats.

extra.why_interesting: The player expects a baking test to involve smell, taste or a timer. A glass of water is the answer, and they can work it out by thinking about bubbles. It mirrors the familiar egg test in reverse: a fresh egg sinks, but a ready starter floats.
extra.verification_notes: The float test is the standard home-baker check: a spoonful of starter that floats in water is considered ready to bake with (https://littlespoonfarm.com/when-is-sourdough-starter-ready).

explanation: Zrelý kvások je plný bubliniek oxidu uhličitého od kvasiniek, a preto je ľahší ako voda. Je to opak testu s vajíčkom: čerstvé vajce klesne ku dnu, ale kvások, ktorý klesne, ešte nie je pripravený.
